subject.title: message-tool send mid-turn writes 'delivery-mirror' side-branch into transcript → permanent HTTP 400 loop, session silently dead

question: Should this issue stay as the coordination tracker for both delivery-mirror side-branch poisoning and empty signed Anthropic thinking replay, or should maintainers split the remaining work to the narrower open PR/issue paths?
rationale: The report combines two related but distinct transcript-replay failures, and current main has partial mitigations plus multiple open candidate PRs; choosing the canonical tracking and landing order is a maintainer coordination decision.

options.title: Coordinate Existing PRs
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100490 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 are reviewed, then close only after both failure classes have current-main proof.

options.title: Split To Narrow Trackers
options.body: Move the signed-thinking evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92201 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and keep this issue focused on delivery-mirror side branches.

options.title: Wait For Reporter Fixtures
options.body: Ask for sanitized JSONL/log excerpts before deciding whether the exact delivery-mirror side-branch shape still reproduces after the current open side-merge fix.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Existing PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100490 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 are reviewed, then close only after both failure classes have current-main proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the active maintainer replacement PR for the side-merge half and is the strongest common routing point across the session-state and replay-policy decision.
